snippet.title: Neo Light – Demo Trailer | Brutal 2D Precision Platformer
snippet.description:
Neo Light is a fast, brutal 2D precision platformer built around tight movement, instant retries, sarcastic humor, satirical bosses, and 9 short-burst powers.

Run, jump, slide, teleport, hover, slow time, create platforms, break obstacles, and master levels that feel impossible until you finally make them look easy.

Play the demo and wishlist Neo Light on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2983530/Neo_Light/

Features:
• Fast 2D precision platforming
• 9 different powers with limited energy
• Instant deaths and instant retries
• Speedrunning routes, timers, best times, and split times
• Voice chat with a sarcastic AI assistant named Glitch
• Satirical enemies and ridiculous boss fights

One dev team.

#NeoLight #IndieGame #SteamDemo #Platformer #PrecisionPlatformer #Speedrun #IndieDev
